label: clean
provenance: Self-contained synthetic fixture authored for V4.3. New holdout family, separate from the earlier development motifs. Only deterministic behavior validation, no live model tuning.

expectation.rationale: api.py defines the complete pagination behavior. In this fixed API the first page is full and the last is short. Both termination rules visit every page, including the last; no other page shapes are in scope.
false_positive_traps: Every cursor-based API can return arbitrary page shapes even when this fixture fixes all responses.
